feeds.title: Student Doctor Network » Dental
feeds.description: Current and previous articles on pre-dentistry, dental school, and dentist (DDS, DMD) related topics. SDN publishes new articles, interviews, podcasts, and features every weekday. The Student Doctor Network was founded by students in 1999 to help students become doctors. All articles are provided free as part of our nonprofit educational mission.

feeds.title: The Articulator Blog
feeds.description: Get news and updates from the University of Bristol Dental School, student stories and achievements and more. The Articulator is a blog from the University of Bristol Dental School.

feeds.title: The Pre-Dental Guide Blog
feeds.description: We specialize in offering advice to get you admitted into dental school. This is a guide written by dental students, for future dental students. Our goal in writing this blog is to assist you in becoming a better applicant for dental or graduate school.

feeds.title: StudentRDH Blog
feeds.description: Find tips and tricks to help you pass the dental hygiene boards and become the amazing RDH you deserve to be. StudentRDH serves thousands of students pass various dental hygiene board exams. My goal is to provide you with everything that you need, so you can pass with confidence.

feeds.title: Dr. Michael Krochak's Pre-Dental Scholarship Blog
feeds.description: Get tips and advice for Dental aspirant students about the application, selecting dental schools and more. We are expert cosmetic dentists committed to improving our patients health, appearance and self-esteem.

feeds.title: Pre-Dental Advice Blog
feeds.description: Are you wondering how to get into dental school? Learn from dental students and dentists through our blog about their experiences. We feature dentists, dental students, and soon-to-be dental students as they share the things they wish they had known as pre-dental students.

feeds.title: New Dentist Blog » Dental Students
feeds.description: New Dentist Now features resources for new dentists and dental students as well as news and insight on the dental profession and beyond. The American Dental Association is America's leading advocate for oral health. We're here to help you stay healthy from the dental chair to daily care at home.
